title: Graduate Partnership Executive
description: <p><strong>About us</strong></p> <p>Fospha is the measurement system enterprise retail and ecommerce brands run their business on. We give marketing teams one clear, daily view of what's actually working — across every channel and everywhere they sell, from their website to Amazon and TikTok Shop — down to the level of a single ad or piece of creative. It replaces guesswork and gut feel with a number marketing, finance and agencies can all trust and act on. Brands including Dyson, Gymshark, Lululemon and many more use Fospha up to 25 times a day to decide where budget should move next. We've spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform - and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin.</p> <p><strong>The Graduate Opportunity at Fospha</strong></p> <p>Joining Fospha’s graduate programme means stepping into a fast-paced environment where you’ll gain real responsibility and exposure from day one. In Partnerships, graduates work directly with some of the world’s biggest digital platforms - like TikTok, Meta, and Snapchat - playing a key role in strengthening relationships, enabling joint initiatives, and driving partner success.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Hands-on exposure to our Partnerships:</strong> Working directly with the platforms such as Tiktok, Meta and Snap, you will build commercial acumen, develop strategic communication skills, and gain a deep understanding of how the digital advertising ecosystem works.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Exposure</strong>: With support, cross-functional collaboration, and the opportunity to make a visible impact early on, it’s the ideal launchpad for ambitious graduates looking to break into the world of ad tech and strategic partnerships.</li> <li><strong>Comprehensive Training</strong>: In addition to the extensive on-the-job learning opportunities, you'll receive a broad and blended in-person training curriculum covering essential topics such as Business Storytelling, Relationship Building, Market Research & Product and Financial Management.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Role:</strong></p> <p>As a <strong>Partnerships Executive</strong>, you'll join a high-impact team focused on enabling, scaling, and deepening Fospha’s relationships with the platforms that power digital marketing.</p> <p>This is a graduate-level role designed to develop future leaders. You’ll be hands-on with major ad platforms, supporting both strategic execution and day-to-day coordination. You’ll also work closely with internal teams - especially Marketing, Product and our Customer Teams - to make sure our partners have what they need to help customers grow.</p> <p><strong>Key responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Supporting our partner managers in coordinating with Google, Meta, TikTok, Snap and others</li> <li>Preparing decks, talking points and training sessions to enable partner sales teams</li> <li>Tracking and reporting on partner performance and engagement</li> <li>Liaising across internal teams to keep initiatives moving and aligned</li> <li>Owning communications or enablement efforts for specific territories or smaller partners</li> <li>Researching and initiating contact with emerging or long-tail partners</li> <li>In addition to your core responsibilities, we expect you to be excited by the opportunity Gen AI brings and find new ways of working utilising our Gen Ai hub!</li> </ul> <p><strong>What are we looking for?</strong></p> <p>We hire for potential – you don’t need a technical degree or marketing background. You should apply if you:</p> <ul> <li>Are an excellent communicator – written, verbal, and visual</li> <li>Are highly organised and detail-oriented</li> <li>Are curious about how marketing, measurement and partnerships work</li> <li>Can handle multiple workstreams and work well under light-touch supervision</li> <li>Thrive in fast-moving, high-growth environments</li> <li>Want to make a real commercial impact from day one</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points For:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with TikTok Ads, Meta, or other digital marketing tools</li> <li>Familiarity with platforms like Notion, HubSpot, Google Sheets</li> <li>Any internship or part-time experience in partnerships, sales, marketing or client-facing roles</li> <li>Like shopping and are a customer of retail brands</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our Values and Principles</strong></p> <p>You will be able to demonstrate examples of our core principles:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Seek inclusion & diversity:</strong> We create an environment where everyone feels welcome, and people are encouraged to speak and be heard</li> <li><strong>Work Hard, Work Well, Work Together:</strong> We take responsibility for making things happen, independently and together; we help colleagues in need and close loops, making sure our work is complete and has lasting impact</li> <li><strong>Grow</strong>: We are proactive, curious and unafraid of failure</li> <li><strong>Customer at the heart</strong>: We care about the customer, feel their pain and love building product that solves their biggest problems</li> <li><strong>Candour with caring:</strong> We deliver candid feedback with kindness and receive it with gratitude</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we can offer you</strong></p> <ul> <li>A workplace pension, through Royal London, with Fospha matching your contributions up to 3%</li> <li>A £1,000/year flexible benefits allowance to put towards private medical insurance, dental cover, a health cash plan, gym membership, extra holiday, or a pension top-up - whatever suits you!</li> <li>Access to Wellhub, giving you one membership across gyms, boutique studios, and wellbeing apps</li> <li>25 days' annual leave plus 8 UK bank holidays, an extra day off for your birthday! and more holiday the longer you stay (26 days after 3 years, 27 after 6)</li> <li>Life assurance worth 4x your annual salary, from day one</li> <li>Cycle to Work scheme, plus discounts on everyday spending through our benefits portal — Apple, Tesco, IKEA, M&S, Deliveroo, cinema tickets and more</li> <li>Quarterly one-to-one sessions with a financial adviser, plus access to payroll-deducted loans through Salary Finance</li> <li>Paid volunteering days each year</li> <li>Regular socials, free weekly snacks, and Lunch & Learn events at our Scale Space office, plus access to the wider Blenheim Chalcot community</li> <li>Opportunities to travel — including to our India and North America offices</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Process</strong></p> <ul> <li>15-minute screening call with a member of the Talent Team</li> <li>30-minute Hiring Manager interview</li> <li>Task and Panel interview</li> <li>Final Exec interview</li> </ul> <p><em>Top tip: Make sure to thoroughly research Fospha and tell us why you would be a great fit for the role!</em></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

tools effectively support client growth targets.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Visionary Leadership:</strong> Extensive experience leading global title: EMEA Account Executive - Emerging Enterprise - London
description: About CodeRabbit CodeRabbit is the governance and control layer for agentic software development, helping engineering teams trust the code they ship. AI can generate code faster than people can review and understand it. Teams still need to know whether each change solves the right problem, fits their architecture, and is safe to ship. We provide independent validation grounded in codebase context and team standards, giving people the evidence they need to judge what should ship. Across Review, Triage, Explain, and Secure, our platform challenges changes before merge, prioritizes pull requests by value, impact, and risk, explains what changed and why it matters, and monitors the codebase for security vulnerabilities after merge. CodeRabbit serves nearly 20,000 customers and supports approximately 300,000 open-source repositories, performing over 2 million code reviews each week. Our $143M Series C, raised at a $1.5B valuation, supports further product development and international expansion. Role Overview We’re looking for founding members of our Emerging Enterprise Account Executive Team in EMEA — sellers who thrive in high-growth environments and can open, develop, and close complex deals in technical markets. You’ll own a list of named prospects in markets across the EMEA region, drive outbound pipeline creation, close the initial deal, and continue to nurture and grow your accounts. This role requires ownership of the entire sales cycle as well as direct revenue responsibility for achieving and exceeding our sales goals. The role requires a deep technical understanding and curiosity to serve as a trusted advisor to prospective customers. What you will do: Own the full sales cycle: prospect, qualify, run PoVs, and close Drive outbound pipeline in named mid-enterprise accounts Deliver high-impact demos and articulate CodeRabbit’s value to both technical and business stakeholders Land and expand — grow usage and footprint across multiple teams Develop business value assessments and quantify ROI with customers Become a product expert and understand the CodeRabbit offering and ecosystem in depth Partner cross-functionally with marketing, product, and customer success to refine playbooks and GTM strategy What You’ll Bring 3+ years of full-cycle quota-carrying experience, preferably in a technical SaaS company Proven success generating outbound pipeline and closing six-figure deals in EMEA Experience selling to engineering leaders (CTOs, VPs Eng, DevOps, etc.) Strong technical curiosity and ability to learn complex products quickly Track record of multi-threaded deal management and value-based selling Excellent communication, organization, and ownership mindset Strong sense of ownership, self-motivation and eagerness to acquire new skills and solve new problems Bonus Points for: Fluent German language skills (written and spoken) Familiarity with AI, developer, and open source technologies Have experience in a Product Led Growth (PLG) company Our Values 🤝 Collaborative Humans: Prioritizing collective intelligence 🚀 Fearless Innovators: Turning obstacles into growth opportunities 💪 Persistent, Passionate Developers: Thriving on complex, long-term challenges 🎯 Impact-Driven Creators: Crafting intuitive tools for developers 🧠 Rapid Learners and Un-learners: Adapting quickly in our fast-paced technological world What We Offer Work on cutting-edge technology with real-world impact Collaborative and innovative environment Competitive salary, equity, and benefits Professional development opportunities To apply, please submit your resume. CodeRabbit is an equal opportunity employer, committed to diversity and inclusion. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Data Platform
description: About Evervault Evervault offers modular payments infrastructure for companies building their own payments stack. We keep raw card data off your systems, cut PCI compliance work, improve acceptance, mitigate fraud and chargebacks and decrease your cost of payments, so you keep full control. Trusted by Ramp, Rippling, Modern Treasury and Overwolf; Series B, led by Ribbit Capital. Role Overview You’ll be the first engineer dedicated to our data platform, and you’ll design and build it largely from scratch. You’ll own the platform that collects our event data, models it, and serves it to customers with roughly 15-second freshness, including building our time-series foundations. This is a senior, hands-on role: you’ll set the architecture, write most of the code and set the bar for the data team that grows around you. You’ll work closely with our VP of Engineering, Product and our leadership team. Product decides which data products to build; you own how they’re built and what the data can support. What You’ll Be Doing Designing and building real-time ingestion for three sources: events our platform already emits, new instrumentation in our product, and data our customers send us Rebuilding our event streaming layer, with the authority to choose how Modelling structured and time-series data in ClickHouse and Databricks so aggregations, trends and benchmarks are fast and cheap at scale (our current defaults, though you can make the case for change) Designing the external data contracts and APIs customers build on, including versioning, reliability and isolation of each customer’s data Defining the event contracts our product engineers instrument against Owning the platform in production: monitoring, data quality, cost and on-call for the systems you build Your First Year In your first few months you’ll assess what we have, decide the platform architecture, and scope our first data product with Product and Engineering. After that, you’ll rebuild the streaming layer and ship the first external product on the new platform, most likely aggregated analytics or direct data access for customers. Later in the year you’ll help us hire a domain expert who decides which signals and benchmarks are worth building. Machine learning is out of scope for now; it comes once we have enough clean historical data. Requirements Production experience building real-time or near-real-time ingestion with event streaming, such as Kafka, Kinesis or Redpanda Deep experience with ClickHouse or a similar analytical database, including modelling time-series data for fast aggregation at volume A track record of shipping an external, multi-tenant data product or data API that customers depended on (internal reporting pipelines alone won’t cover this) Experience migrating a messy live system to a new one without downtime or data loss Senior-level engineering habits: system design, testing, and running the services you build in production Sound judgement working independently: you’ll be our most senior data voice, and we’ll rely on your technical calls A product mindset: you won’t work directly with customers, but you’ll often be the person who knows what the data can and can’t support Nice to Have Experience in payments or with sensitive, regulated data Databricks or Spark experience alongside ClickHouse Experience as an early or founding member of a data team, including hiring This Might Not Be for You If… You’re mainly an analyst, BI or data science specialist: this role builds the platform and the external products on it Your experience is mostly dashboards, internal reporting pipelines or modelling for analysis You want a hands-off architect role: you’ll write most of the code You want to work fully remotely: we’re in our Shoreditch office Tuesday to Thursday Compensation, Benefits & Why Join Competitive salary Stock options with an extended exercise window Private health insurance Unlimited PTO & flexible working hours Daily lunch budget Build a company’s data platform from the first line of code, with the authority to make the big architectural calls and work directly with C-Level Interview Process Recruiter Screen Hiring Manager Interview Technical Interview System Design Interview Final with our Founder References and Offer Location This role is based in London, in our Shoreditch office Tuesday to Thursday. We do not currently sponsor UK work visas. Candidates must be based in the location specified. Any applications from candidates not in the required location may not receive a response. title: Senior Underwriter
description: About Ryft Ryft is a regulated payment facilitator and authorised payment institution building the infrastructure layer for modern commerce platforms. We enable marketplaces, SaaS platforms and multi-party ecosystems to embed and monetise payments natively. Our technology handles onboarding, compliance, orchestration, split payments and revenue sharing, allowing our partners to focus on growth while we manage complexity. We are now entering the next phase of scale, expanding into new verticals and building a category-defining embedded payments platform. About the role We are looking for an experienced Senior Underwriter to join our Underwriting team. As a Payment Facilitator, we onboard and oversee our merchants directly. You will assess and onboard a varied portfolio of these merchants, with a focus on marketplaces and platforms. You will own complex underwriting cases from start to finish. This includes reviewing ownership structures and financial health, setting risk exposure limits, and making clear recommendations that protect the business while helping our merchants grow. This is a senior position. You will be expected to use sound independent judgement, guide less experienced colleagues, and help improve our underwriting policies, procedures and tools. Key responsibilities - Lead the end-to-end underwriting and onboarding of merchants, including complex cases, ensuring decisions follow internal risk appetite, regulatory requirements and card scheme rules. - Underwrite marketplaces and platforms, assessing the business model, flow of funds and customer journey. - Onboard merchants with complex organisational structures, including multi-layered ownership, group entities and cross-border structures, identifying ultimate beneficial owners and controllers. - Screen merchants, directors, UBOs and connected parties for PEP status, sanctions and adverse media using screening tools, and assess and escalate potential matches appropriately. - Review merchant websites using third-party website monitoring providers to identify content violations, prohibited or restricted products and services, missing or inadequate terms and conditions, refund and privacy policies, and inconsistencies with the declared business model. - Carry out credit risk analysis on merchants by reviewing financial statements, management accounts and bank statements to evaluate liquidity, profitability, solvency and trading patterns. - Assess financial exposure, including chargeback, refund and delivery risk (e.g., future delivery and prepayment models), and recommend suitable mitigants. - Write clear, well-reasoned underwriting summaries and recommendations for approval, setting out key risks, mitigants and the rationale behind each decision. - Conduct periodic reviews and re-underwriting of existing merchants, monitoring changes in risk profile, processing behaviour and financial standing. - Work with Sales, Risk, Compliance and other teams to give timely, commercially aware risk decisions. - Coach and support junior underwriters, reviewing their cases and sharing knowledge across the team. Requirements Essential: - Extensive experience in merchant underwriting, merchant onboarding and credit risk within payments, acquiring, a payment service provider or a related financial services environment. - Strong knowledge of KYB/KYC, AML and CTF requirements as they apply to merchant onboarding. - Hands-on experience with PEP, sanctions and adverse media screening tools, and with investigating and resolving potential matches. - Experience onboarding businesses with complex ownership and organisational structures, and identifying UBOs. - The ability to perform in-depth credit risk analysis, including interpreting financial statements and bank statements and assessing a merchant's financial strength and risk exposure. - Sound judgement and the confidence to make and defend risk decisions while balancing commercial objectives. - Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage several complex cases at once. - Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to produce concise, well-structured risk summaries and recommendations. - Fluent written and spoken English. Desirable: - Experience with higher-risk sectors such as travel, CBD or charities. - Knowledge of card scheme risk programmes (e.g., VAMP, MATCH, BRAM) and reserve setting. - Familiarity with tools such as Dotfile, HubSpot, G2, Endole. title: Machine Learning Researcher
description: Company Neuphonic is building the future of on-device voice AI. We develop ultra-low-latency voice models that enable super-realistic, human-like speech directly on devices. Our focus is on building efficient generative audio models and infrastructure that can run on CPU-constrained hardware, enabling real-time voice interaction without relying on large cloud infrastructure. By dramatically reducing latency and compute requirements, we're making natural conversational AI possible on phones, embedded devices, browsers, and edge systems. This requires building high-performance systems that bridge machine learning, real-time audio processing, and distributed infrastructure. Neuphonic was founded in April 2024 and has raised significant funding from leading European investors. We work with global enterprises across hardware and consumer AI that are building the next generation of voice-enabled products. Our open source models have been downloaded over 4 million times and earned over 6,500 GitHub stars since launch. Our vision is a world where voice becomes the most natural interface for AI, enabling seamless, intuitive interactions that are accessible to everyone. Please review our Hugging Face and GitHub repos before applying, as they’ll be part of the interview discussion. Role We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to help advance the state of the art in speech synthesis. You will work on research and development across the full speech pipeline — from model architecture and training to dataset design and production deployment. The role combines applied research with real-world engineering, working closely with a small team pushing the boundaries of real-time speech systems. We are particularly interested in candidates with experience in text-to-speech systems, or multimodal machine learning involving speech and audio. Your work will include: Researching and developing state-of-the-art speech synthesis models Training and optimising models for high-quality, low-latency speech generation Building and curating high-quality proprietary speech datasets Improving model quality, expressiveness, and latency Working closely with engineers to bring research models into production systems Exploring multimodal approaches to speech and conversational AI This role is best suited to candidates who have worked on research-grade machine learning models , rather than purely application-level ML systems. You have An MSc or PhD in machine learning, speech processing, computer science, or a closely related field Strong experience training and evaluating deep learning models using frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow Several years of research or industry experience developing machine learning models (this is not a graduate or entry-level role) In addition, you should have experience in one of the following areas: Text-to-speech (TTS) or speech synthesis, including model architecture, training, or evaluation or multimodal machine learning involving audio, such as models combining speech, text, or audio modalities Experience working in research-oriented ML environments, such as academic labs, advanced research teams, or deep-tech startups Familiarity with state-of-the-art approaches in speech generation, audio modelling, or multimodal systems Experience reading and implementing recent ML research papers Background from top universities, leading research groups, or equivalent research experience A strong interest in speech technology and conversational AI Benefits Help us set the company culture - you’d be joining us as part of our founding team. Help us set and guide the company culture! Competitive salary and equity - we want to make sure you’re rewarded not just in financial terms but also have a sizeable stake in the business as well. We’re in this together. Private health insurance - your health and well-being is paramount. We want to make sure that everyone in the company is supported when it comes to health. Conference, travel and development budget - your development will also grow the business. We want to make sure that you have access to the resources and opportunities you need to be at your best Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Infrastructure / Platform Engineer (London)
description: Location: London, UK Type: Full-time, in office About Neuphonic Neuphonic is building the next generation of voice AI, making natural, real-time speech accessible across devices, languages, and applications. Our technology enables ultra-low-latency text-to-speech, voice cloning, and multilingual speech generation. We're pushing the boundaries of what's possible with speech models, from high-performance cloud inference to running AI directly on everyday devices without expensive GPUs or an internet connection. We're a small, ambitious team of researchers and engineers building technology used by developers and businesses around the world. Our open-source releases have reached millions of downloads, and we're growing quickly. Why we're hiring As our customer base grows, we need to scale our production infrastructure while maintaining the performance, reliability, and low latency that our products depend on. We're looking for an Infrastructure / Platform Engineer to take ownership of our cloud infrastructure and inference systems. You'll work closely with our engineering and ML teams to build scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient systems. What you'll own Cloud infrastructure: Build, manage, and scale our production infrastructure across GCP and GPU cloud providers using Kubernetes, Docker, and Terraform. Inference optimisation: Continuously improve inference performance, latency, throughput, GPU utilisation, and infrastructure costs through profiling, experimentation, and iteration, rather than simply maintaining the status quo. Platform evolution: Identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in how we build, deploy, and serve models, and take ownership of implementing improvements. Production reliability: Monitor critical systems, respond to incidents, and help ensure reliable service for our customers outside UK working hours. Infrastructure architecture: Make autonomous technical decisions that balance scalability, reliability, performance, and cost. CI/CD and automation: Improve deployment pipelines, infrastructure automation, monitoring, and observability. Security and enterprise readiness: Support secure infrastructure practices and enterprise deployment requirements. What we're looking for Strong experience building and operating production cloud infrastructure at scale , ideally supporting applications with significant user traffic. Hands-on experience with GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and Python . Experience with CI/CD, monitoring, observability, and production incident response. A strong understanding of infrastructure performance, scalability, and cost optimisation. Experience participating in on-call rotations or taking responsibility for production incidents. A proactive approach to engineering, with experience identifying bottlenecks, experimenting with improvements, and optimising production systems. Comfortable working autonomously, making architectural decisions, and taking ownership of critical systems. Nice to have Experience with AI/ML inference, GPU infrastructure, or vLLM. Experience hosting audio, speech, or real-time AI applications. Experience with C++. Familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 27001, or other security compliance frameworks. Experience with private cloud or on-premise enterprise deployments. Who you'll work with You'll work directly with our engineering and ML teams, helping shape the infrastructure behind Neuphonic's production models and services. We're a small team, so you'll have real ownership and the freedom to make meaningful technical decisions. We value people who take initiative, solve problems independently, and enjoy building systems that work reliably in the real world. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Partner Account Executive, UK - Insurance
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the Role: We are looking for a strategic and results-driven Senior Partner Account Executive to launch, scale, and optimise partnerships across our ecosystem with a focus on insurance carriers and brokers. Samsara's telematics and dashcam technology already help thousands of customers improve safety and reduce risk - this role will accelerate those benefits by developing high-impact partnerships that drive mutual growth. You will be the face of Samsara to insurance executives, building scalable programmes that directly influence customer acquisition, retention, and loss cost improvement. If you thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments, are motivated by measurable business impact, and enjoy turning ideas into reality, this is your opportunity to make a difference. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. In this role you will: Own and grow our relationships with insurance carriers, brokers and MGAs in the UK Design and run partner programmes that drive customer acquisition, retention and loss-cost improvement - and the Samsara revenue that comes with them Map accounts with partners, pick joint targets and bring Samsara sales into the deals Build the playbook: how we qualify, onboard and scale insurance partnerships You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact - helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your partners are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live. Samsara's top employees do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline. You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. You want to develop the playbook, not just follow one: Our partner ecosystem is young. You'll define how we take partners to value - from first conversation to joint customers - and build the model that lets those partnerships deliver maximum value for Samsara at scale. You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. You build genuine relationships with your partners and our customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time. You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. Minimum requirements for the role: Strong sales, partnerships, or business development experience, ideally within a B2B technology or insurance-related field and a track record of overachievement. A builder mentality - you thrive in ambiguous environments and know how to create structure, process, and scale. A strategic and data-driven mindset, using insights to optimise programmes and drive revenue. Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple initiatives simultaneously. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Samsara is seeking a high-impact, strategic seller to lead the go-to-market execution for our newest frontiers in Connected Equipment. As an Enterprise Specialist (Overlay), you will partner with our Account Executives (AEs) to build deep partnerships with our largest, most complex accounts. You aren't just selling a tool; you are pioneering GTM, ensuring our customers realize continuous value from new products as a part of the overall platform. This specialist reports into the VP of Sales, EMEA and will be aligned by segment and product. AEs on the team are charged with accelerating the growth of one or more new product(s) and will be incentivized on quarterly product sales targets mapped to mainline sellers in the segment. Product Specialist sellers drive growth through strategic, high-value deal executing and enabling the segment overall to be successful. This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you're meeting with a VP of Operations in waste management; the next, you're diving into the logistics of a global food distributor. You seek to understand the "unit of value" for every customer. You build genuine, high-stakes relationships: Our customers operate in "boots-on-the-ground" industries. They value earned trust and partners who understand their operational realities. You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. You are a team Player: In an overlay role, your success is tied to the success of the broader account team. You lead through influence, not just authority. In this role, you will: Architect deals that align Samsara's new products value with customer use cases to provide maximum value and return on investment Co-generate new product pipeline with ADRs/AEs across high propensity to buy accounts Drive strategy and pilot/trial success Provide commercial insights and pricing benchmarks often for unique set of competitors in the market Partner with GTM and Product to feed back insights and help shape roadmap Build frameworks, assets and insights that scale across the sales org Travel 20%+ to meet customers where they physically operate and to advance solutions and deals Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices Minimum requirements for the role: 5+ years in complex, full-cycle Enterprise sales. Proven Track Record: Consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts with £500k+/€500k+ ARR transactions. Deal Complexity: Demonstrated success navigating 6- and 7-figure deals involving multiple stakeholders (Legal, Procurement, InfoSec, and C-Suite). Entrepreneurial Agility: Experience selling new products where the playbook is still being written. An ideal candidate also has: Experience working in a specialist/overlay co-selling with a mainline AE team. Second language experience in French or German at business-level proficiency. Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. Belonging at Samsara At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. Accommodations Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. If you're currently at a startup that's struggling to find its footing, or a business where the hiring bar has dropped just to fill seats, you know exactly how fragile that 'growth' story feels. Samsara is the exception. We are a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. Strong Backgrounds successful in this role: The Agency Foundation: You started your career in a fast-paced recruiting agency. Technical Acumen: You can speak the language of sales. You know the difference between an order-taker and a territory owner. You have experience hiring for a scaling playbook environment and understand how to identify the elite within this market from the B players. The Ideal Candidate is: Foundational Mastery: The goal is to bridge the gap between execution and influence. You are here to build the bulletproof foundations of an exceptional recruiter—learning how to own a region, influence high-level stakeholders, and use data as a weapon. Focused & Structured: You understand that structuring your inputs—sourcing volume, message personalization, and rigorous screening—is the only way to get consistent output. Data-Minded: You study your own conversion rates and market talent availability to stay ahead of hiring needs. Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You iterate on your outreach and your screening questions based on what the data tells you. What's in it for you? Build the Foundation for Leadership: We believe leadership is a set of skills, not just a job title. In this role, you will develop the data literacy to lead a boardroom with metrics, the strategic insight to advise VPs on market conditions, and the technical acumen to assess elite GTM talent. Elite Exposure: You will be exposed to a broad range of international roles and learn from some of the best sales and recruiting leaders in the industry. We are building for the long term, which means your career development here is backed by real revenue, not just a VC's hopes. Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. title: Technical Product Manager, Developer Experience & Product-Led Growth
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Telnyx</strong></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a </span></em><a href="https://telnyx.com/our-network"><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">private, global, multi-cloud IP network</span></em></a><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">, to bringing </span></em><a href="https://telnyx.com/resources/about-edge-connectivity"><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">hyperlocal edge</span></em></a><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"> technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.</span></em></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.</span></em></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.</span></em></p></div><p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a highly technical Product Manager to own how developers discover, build on and grow with Telnyx.</p> <p>Telnyx operates a global infrastructure platform spanning communications, AI inference, GPUs, edge compute, databases and real-time applications. We've invested heavily in building the underlying infrastructure. Now we want to make it dramatically easier for developers to understand what's possible, build useful applications and get into production.</p> <p>This is a hands-on product role leading a small team of six engineers across Developer Relations and Product-Led Growth. We aren't looking for a traditional DevRel leader or someone whose primary skill is managing people. We want a strong engineer with excellent product judgment who understands developer experience, builds things personally and knows how to turn developer adoption into revenue. </p> <p><strong>The Team</strong></p> <p>You'll lead a team of six: three DevRel engineers (sample apps, open source, technical content and demos) and three PLG engineers (activation, AI agents and automation, self-service conversion and expansion). You'll report to the Chief Operating Officer. </p> <p><strong>What you'll own</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build applications developers actually want to use — Lead the DevRel team in building production-quality sample applications, integrations, templates and reference implementations on Telnyx. Publish them on GitHub, maintain them and make them easy for developers to deploy and extend. Turn those applications into compelling technical content, live demos and developer distribution.</li> <li>Drive product-led growth — Own the PLG operation responsible for moving developers from signup to meaningful usage and revenue. Use product telemetry, behavioral signals, AI agents and human intervention to identify friction, accelerate onboarding, improve conversion and expand self-service usage.</li> <li>Make the developer experience better — Get hands-on with our APIs, SDKs, documentation and infrastructure. Work directly with product engineering to identify and resolve the issues that make products difficult to use. Our reference applications should continuously test whether our products are genuinely ready for developers.</li> <li>Build AI-native growth systems — Work with Growth Engineering and RevOps to develop automated workflows for developer acquisition, onboarding, account intelligence, technical assistance and expansion. We believe small teams of excellent technical people supervising powerful automation can outperform much larger traditional GTM organizations.</li> <li>Connect the entire developer journey — Applications attract developers. Developers experiment with the platform. PLG helps them succeed. Production usage generates revenue. The feedback from that process improves our products and informs what we build next. You'll be accountable for making that system work. .</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we're looking for</strong></p> <ul> <li>A strong software engineering background. You should be comfortable building and debugging real applications, working with APIs, reading code and understanding complex infrastructure.</li> <li>Experience as a Technical Product Manager, founding engineer, technical founder or similar role with substantial personal responsibility for shipping software.</li> <li>Exceptional product judgment, particularly around developer tools, APIs, documentation, onboarding and usability.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI infrastructure, LLMs, inference, cloud platforms, real-time systems or developer infrastructure.</li> <li>Understanding of product-led growth, including developer acquisition, activation, conversion, retention and monetization.</li> <li>Ability to work with AI coding agents, automation frameworks, product analytics and modern developer tooling.</li> <li>Strong technical communication skills. You can explain complicated technologies clearly and recognize what makes a useful demonstration or reference application.</li> <li>Comfortable leading a small technical team while remaining deeply involved in the actual work.</li> </ul> <p>Experience at a developer infrastructure company is valuable. Experience personally building and growing something developers love is more important.</p> <p><strong>How we'll measure success</strong></p> <p><strong>Your primary objective is growing developer-led revenue on Telnyx.</strong></p> <p>We'll look at activated developers, production applications deployed, self-service conversion, usage expansion and retention. We'll also measure the adoption of our reference applications, how effectively our developer content attracts users and how quickly developers can get from signup to a working application.</p> <p>We care about applications developers actually use, not demos shipped for the sake of demos. We care about developers reaching production, not just generating signups. And we care about revenue, not vanity metrics.</p> <p><strong>Who will thrive here</strong></p> <p>Someone who would rather build a working prototype than spend a week debating a roadmap. Someone who notices a broken onboarding experience and immediately starts fixing it. Someone who understands both what makes infrastructure technically excellent and what makes developers want to use it.</p> <p>You should be capable of leading six very technical people because you have the engineering ability, product instincts and judgment to make everyone around you more effective.</p> <p><strong>This is a builder's job, not a professional management job.</strong></p> <p>We're looking for someone who can make Telnyx a platform developers genuinely love building on, and turn that into a meaningful business.</p> <h6><span style="font-weight: 400;">#LI-RH1</span></h6><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <p> </p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Customer Trust Specialist
description: About Us: Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI. About the role We're looking for a Customer Trust Specialist to join our London office and help run the customer-facing side of our trust program. Where our GRC team keeps the compliance engine running behind the scenes, you'll be one of the people customers actually interact with, turning our security, privacy, and AI-governance posture into accurate answers that earn trust. You'll handle security questionnaires end to end, help operate our trust automation platform, and support customer conversations across EMEA and beyond. This is a great fit for someone with solid security-review experience who wants to grow their scope at a fast-scaling AI company. What you'll do Handle security questionnaires end to end: intake, drafting, review, and delivery for customer security assessments, RFPs, and vendor evaluations, in whatever format they arrive (OneTrust, spreadsheets, portals, email), pulling in Security, Legal, or Engineering when an answer needs it. Operate our trust automation platform: use and help improve the system that generates answers from our governed knowledge base. Review output for accuracy, flag weak or incorrect answers, and help keep the guardrails from over-claiming. Keep the knowledge base current: update answers as the platform, certifications, and control environment change; ingest new evidence (SOC 2, ISO 27001/27701/42001, HIPAA, penetration tests); and flag stale facts before they reach a customer. Handle one-off customer requests: evidence requests, Trust Center access, point questions from account teams, and anything that doesn't fit a questionnaire but still shapes a customer's confidence. Support customer calls: join prospect and customer calls alongside Sales and Solutions to field security, privacy, and AI-safety questions, especially for UK and EMEA customers. Partner with the sales team from intake through close. Support contract reviews: work with Legal and Deal Desk on security and privacy terms in DPAs and MSAs, including UK GDPR and EU data-transfer questions; learn which positions are standard and which need escalation. Keep the program honest: follow the standing rules that protect us and our customers: state only our standard position, never reference another customer's ask or situation, and escalate anything that needs Legal, Security, or Engineering sign-off. Track program data: log knowledge-base gaps, recurring questions we can't answer well yet, and where automation is saving or costing time, and share findings with the team. Help maintain public trust artifacts: keep the Trust Center, security whitepapers, and supporting evidence current and aligned with what we actually do. How the role will grow As you build context on our platform and customers, you'll take on more ownership: Broader program ownership: lead specific parts of the program, such as a framework area, a slice of the knowledge base, or EMEA customer coverage. AI-assurance coverage: help extend the knowledge base to emerging standards like ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, and the EU AI Act. Cross-functional influence: work more closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Sales to make our security and AI-safety posture a differentiator rather than a checkbox. What we're looking for 3 to 5 years of experience in customer-facing security, trust, or GRC roles: security assurance, customer trust, vendor security review, security-focused sales engineering, or similar. Hands-on experience with security questionnaires and the customer security-review process across formats (CAIQ, SIG, custom spreadsheets, OneTrust and similar portals) and frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR/UK GDPR, NIST). Some exposure to contracts (DPAs, MSAs) and the ability to connect contract language to a company's actual security controls. Strong written communication; you can turn a control requirement into a clear, accurate answer, and you know the difference between answering a question and over-answering it. Working knowledge of cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and SaaS architectures; comfortable discussing encryption, isolation, and data flows with technical buyers. Interest in trust automation and AI-assisted tooling, with an understanding that automation needs guardrails. A precise, detail-oriented mindset; you catch the answer that is almost right, and you treat a customer-facing representation as something that has to be true. A collaborative, low-ego approach, and good judgment about when to escalate rather than answer. Comfortable working with a US-based team, including some overlap with US Eastern hours. Bonus: familiarity with AI/ML platforms, LLM inference, or AI governance concepts (zero data retention, content guardrails, EU AI Act). Why Fireworks? Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving. Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally. Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results. Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation. Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Chief of Staff, CFO

Shape executive and Board communication: Support the CFO in the creation of internal and external-facing materials, including Board, Exec and Investor materials. Build the CFO go-to-market programme: partner with GTM to run CFO-hosted events, roundtables and a community for finance leaders, and track the commercial impact. Experience with M&A/corporate finance (including fundraising) Experience building executive events or communities. An entrepreneurial streak: you’ve founded a business or side project. title: Quality Assurance Engineer (Automation)
description: Quality Assurance Engineer (Automation) The Role You’ll own the quality of the Lyrebird platform, from the first commit to the release gate. This is a hands-on, code-first engineering role, not manual test scripting. You’ll make our Playwright end-to-end and integration suites faster and more reliable, build contract tests that stop backend changes from silently breaking the web app, and design ways to evaluate clinical model output where exact-match assertions don’t work. You’ll also be the quality partner to our SRE function, giving them the health checks, synthetic monitors, load test results and post-deployment signals they need. When a release is ready to go, you’ll give a clear yes or no, backed by evidence. This role suits an engineer who sees testing as a craft and treats a test suite as production code. You’re comfortable moving between TypeScript and Python in the same day, you get real satisfaction from deleting a flaky test and cutting minutes off a pipeline, and you’d rather help other engineers write better tests than be the only person who writes them. You’ll enjoy the hard problem at the centre of this role: how to prove that non-deterministic AI output is safe and accurate enough for clinicians to rely on. About Us Lyrebird Health is transforming the quality and accessibility of healthcare by automating clinicians’ most time-consuming tasks. Thousands of clinicians across multiple disciplines use Lyrebird every day in environments where accuracy, safety, and time matter deeply. Everything we build is grounded in earning trust, reducing cognitive load, and delivering meaningful impact at scale. What you’ll do Optimise our Playwright end-to-end suite, cutting run time and removing flaky tests for good Extend our API and partner integration suites, and build contract tests from our OpenAPI schemas so no backend change can break the web app without warning Add coverage gates to our Buildkite pipeline, using reporting that already breaks quality down by product area Support and collaborate with our engineering teams with CICD development and oversight Test the clinical output of our models with DeepEval, openevals and Langfuse traces, designing evaluations that hold up when responses change from run to run Run load tests with Locust ahead of major releases and hand clear findings to the SRE function Build the signals SRE depends on: health checks, synthetic monitors and post-deployment tests Own the release quality gate, giving a clear yes or no with the evidence behind it Raise the standard of testing across engineering through shared patterns, fixtures and thoughtful code review What you’ll bring Strong test automation experience in both TypeScript and Python, writing tests as production-quality code Deep hands-on experience with Playwright, plus component testing with Vitest and Testing Library Solid pytest skills, including async tests, fixtures, mocking and test data factories such as polyfactory or Faker Experience running tests in CI pipelines (ideally Buildkite) and in Docker, with coverage measurement and reporting Working knowledge of SQL and Postgres, and confidence testing at the database layer Experience with API contract testing against OpenAPI schemas Nice to have Experience evaluating large language model output with tools such as DeepEval, openevals or Langfuse Load testing experience with Locust Familiarity with Svelte, Storybook, or Supabase and its CLI-based database testing Experience with observability tools such as Sentry, OpenTelemetry and Honeycomb A background in healthcare, clinical software or other regulated, safety-critical environments Every test you write protects a clinician who is relying on Lyrebird in the middle of a busy day, and the patient sitting in front of them. When our platform is fast, stable and trustworthy, clinicians spend less time on admin and more time on care. You’ll be the person who makes sure we can promise that with confidence, release after release. We’re building a team that reflects the diversity of the people who benefit from our work. We want Lyrebird to be a place where everyone feels safe, supported, and able to thrive. title: Mobile Application Engineer
description: Mobile Application Engineer The Role Lyrebird’s product lives or dies in a single moment: a clinician starting a consultation and trusting that every word is being captured. Today, that moment happens in the browser. As our first Mobile Application Engineer, you’ll take ownership of bringing Lyrebird to iOS and Android, starting with the capability that matters most: reliable audio capture on a phone. You’ll own the mobile application end to end, from the build pipeline and store releases to bringing our core web features into a native experience that works in the real conditions clinicians face every day. This role suits someone who enjoys being the person who owns the whole thing. You’re comfortable moving between native platform APIs and a TypeScript codebase, you care about the unglamorous details (permissions, interruptions, flaky networks), and you get satisfaction from shipping something that simply works when it matters. You’ll enjoy the autonomy of shaping a platform from its early days, and the responsibility of building for people who can’t afford for their tools to fail mid-consultation. About Us Lyrebird Health is transforming the quality and accessibility of healthcare by automating clinicians’ most time-consuming tasks. Thousands of clinicians across multiple disciplines use Lyrebird every day in environments where accuracy, safety, and time matter deeply. Everything we build is grounded in earning trust, reducing cognitive load, and delivering meaningful impact at scale. What you’ll do Implement and own the mobile build pipeline, producing signed iOS and Android builds and keeping configuration current Release the app to the App Store and Google Play, managing versioning, phased rollouts, and store review Deliver mobile audio capture for consultations, handling microphone permissions, background recording, and interruptions such as incoming phone calls Make audio uploads resilient on poor networks, with retry and resume built in Bring mature web features into the mobile app, matching their behaviour and resilience whilst adapting the experience for small screens Optimise reporting and telemetry, then use what you learn to make the app more stable Build and maintain the mobile test suite and run it as part of the build pipeline Keep across platform changes from Apple and Google and plan the work they require What you’ll bring Strong experience in cross-platform development (React Native). title: Engineering Manager
description: Who are we At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel. By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost. Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control. Location While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain. This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis. About the Team We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a cross-functional team in our Product Engineering organization. Each of our engineering teams owns a product domain at Lokalise, from vision to delivery. Teams talk to customers, find out what they need, set their own goals and choose how to solve the problems that matter most. AI is already part of how we build software at Lokalise, and it's changing what great engineering leadership looks like. We're looking for a leader who stays close to the work and understands how AI is changing speed, quality and engineers' day-to-day experience. You'll keep your teams focused on outcomes that matter to our customers and our business, not just on how much gets shipped. For this role, you'll lead our Editing Experience team. The team owns the tools linguists and reviewers use every day to translate, review and approve content at scale: the translation editor, the review and approval workflow, content management tools and the developer utilities that support them. Together with your Product Manager and Designer, you'll own the team's strategy and delivery end to end. What You Will Do Lead, coach and develop your teams of Software Engineers. You'll support their career growth, run performance evaluations, contribute to compensation planning and hire engineers who raise the bar. Stay technically close to the work without becoming a bottleneck. You'll review key designs and pull requests, pair with engineers on tricky problems and take on contributions outside the critical path (such as tooling, prototypes or small fixes). This keeps you in touch with the codebase and your teams' daily reality while they own delivery. Partner with Product Managers and Designers (the Product Triad) to understand our customers deeply and take part in discovery. You'll make sure your teams work on the right problems, putting outcomes ahead of outputs. Connect engineering decisions to business impact. Understand how your domain contributes to customer value, retention and revenue, and use that to guide trade-offs on scope, investment and technical debt. Own your teams' flow of work from start to finish. Track and act on delivery and quality signals (such as cycle time, deployment frequency, change failure rate and recovery time), clear bottlenecks across planning, review, testing and release, and keep cognitive load sustainable. Lead your teams' move to AI-native engineering across the SDLC. Embed AI tools and agentic workflows, measure their real effect on speed, quality and how engineers experience their work, and adapt team practices so faster delivery never costs reliability or maintainability. Champion operational excellence. Drive reliability and quality practices, own the health of the services your teams run and step in as Incident Commander when needed. Own your teams' delivery: set quarterly plans, track progress against the product roadmap and help shape department-wide planning and strategy. What You Must Have 3+ years of recent experience as an Engineering Manager leading software engineering teams, ideally in SaaS product companies. A strong software engineering background, and you're still hands-on today. You can review code and designs credibly, dig into technical issues and contribute to architecture decisions. Proven people leadership: hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management and helping engineers grow into their next role. A strong product engineering mindset. You've partnered with Product and Design on discovery, worked directly with customers and measured success by customer and business outcomes rather than output. Business acumen. You understand the commercial context, can explain trade-offs in terms of impact and communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels. Experience using engineering metrics and flow practices (such as DORA metrics, cycle time or WIP limits) to find bottlenecks and improve delivery, quality and team health, without turning metrics into targets. Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development and agentic tools, both in your own work and across a team. You have a clear view of how AI changes delivery speed, code quality, review practices and cognitive load. Experience planning and delivering complex initiatives across several teams predictably, including managing dependencies, risks and incidents. It's a Plus If You Have None of these are required, and we're happy to support you as you learn them on the job. Experience in the localization industry or with translation workflows. Experience leading engineering teams at a product company during a scale-up phase. Experience shipping AI-powered product features, such as LLM-based features, to customers. Experience managing fully remote, distributed teams. Familiarity with developer experience or productivity frameworks, such as SPACE or DevEx. Our Benefits 💰 Competitive salary and employee stock options. 🌍 Fully remote setup with flexible working hours. 🏢 Co-working budget — for those days you want a change from your home office. 🌴 Flexible vacation policy to recharge when you need to. 🖥️ Home office setup budget — monitor, desk, ergonomics, whatever helps you do your best work. 📚 Learning & development budget to grow your skills and career. 🏥 Health insurance to keep you covered. 🧘 Wellness allowance to support your mental and physical well-being. 🤝 Great startup culture — remote but close-knit, with regular retreats and social events to stay connected. We are committed to a culture of inclusion and equal opportunities. Therefore, we welcome applications from people of all gender identities, sexual orientations, personal expressions, relationship, marital, or civil partnership statuses, racial identities, national or ethnic origins, religious beliefs, ages, and disability statuses. We're early.
